description: This file implements an HTTP handler for managing Nostr profiles, including endpoints for retrieving, updating, and importing profiles, with rate limiting, concurrency control, and security checks.

classes.name: NostrProfileHttpContext
classes.description: Interface defining context methods and properties for profile HTTP handling, including profile retrieval, update, account info, and logging.

methods.name: createNostrProfileHttpHandler
methods.description: Creates an HTTP handler function for profile management endpoints, routing requests based on URL and method.

methods.name: clearNostrProfileRateLimitStateForTest
methods.description: Clears the rate limiter state for testing purposes.

methods.name: getNostrProfileRateLimitStateSizeForTest
methods.description: Returns the current size of the rate limiter state for testing.

methods.name: isNostrProfileRateLimitedForTest
methods.description: Checks if an account is rate limited at a given timestamp, for testing.

methods.name: validateUrlSafety
methods.description: Validates that a URL uses HTTPS and does not point to private/internal addresses, protecting against SSRF.
